notes.title: 0.9.3 update AVAILABLE NOW - WINDOWS BETA BRANCH
notes.content:
Hey Everybody, 

Finally 0.9.3 update is for for Train Station Simulator. This new update is only available for PC / Windows right now. With your help I need to sort out errors and bugs before I upload the MAC and Linux versions as well. 

Let me show all the added new features one by one with the images: 

[h1]1. TRAIN INTERIORS[/h1]

I have enabled train interiors for most of the train carriages (except for a few ones). In this update you will not see passengers sitting in the train carriages it will be added later on and some interior changes will come as well. But feel free to test the game and see what each of the trains look inside. Here is a few screenshots:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31135360/e5297366a2a18f4b4a0fe9a6a35f2ce63fb2ded5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31135360/a86ec817aca973822ab2d73688c2cf6fc6d187c3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31135360/720a3200487ffca83f4094804cb85e7326d4e04a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31135360/d520b98826a46f78ca9fc12d473594795095fa9e.png[/img]

[h1]2. Freight train additions[/h1]

Many more new freight train types have been added. With some new cool looking engines and also the addition of new carriages. The new type of goods will be added to a latest update to your freight station and it will generate different amounts of revenue. This will result more fun of the freight option of the game. See a screenshot of one of the new trains: 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31135360/d205659886ccea18d45d3c400f29a7f5c369f451.png[/img]

[h1]3. Freight terminal additions[/h1]

Moreover not just new trains and engines will appear but players will be able to create a more complex freight termina. Right now I only enabled the new buildings for a look and overview but the freight terminal will be more detailed by time. New train types also appear on your freight train track time to time. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31135360/a9bc2aecce49dda33cb81128a190c47c7252da75.png[/img]

[h1]4. Cleaning staff's zoning[/h1]

The zoning option for cleaning stuff is almost ready. I can show you a screenshot what it is like in the game. Unfortunately it is not working yet properly, hopefully in the upcoming weeks I can finalize this function as well. New zonings will look pretty nice. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31135360/8280f7d0b3736522a609b7950c2bd9136d0121bb.png[/img]

[h1]5-6-7. New VIP areas, carriages[/h1]

There is a new VIP Shop a Jewelry shop. You can influence your VIP passengers with these new VIP only facilities. Your VIP passengers might feel more comfortable and happy if they see greater shops for their needs. The antique VIP carraige is not yet finished but will come in the upcoming weeks as well. Jewelry shop is available in 1980-2010 years. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31135360/2e4c77cd555e44b8b2d19443ebce15ed35548b05.png[/img]

[h1]8. Large Restaurant Court [/h1]
Now you can place a much larger Restaurant area to your station with a larger variety of food types. Check it out. Available in 1990-2010 years. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31135360/0170b93d695c7a49a3ebb4083a11568553150e33.png[/img]

[h1]9. Food Truck [/h1]

A new larger food truck is available to your station as well. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31135360/2e4c77cd555e44b8b2d19443ebce15ed35548b05.png[/img]

I have managed to fix a few bugs. There was a major problems with the UI not in place in some versions of the game. It seems to be fixed now, but multi monitor setup might have some more problems still. I will look into those problems in the new updates as well. 

I have also managed to fix a few object related error, issues not placing benches properly. 

That is for now with this update if you find any problems please report it in the thread or in the community session of Train Station Simulator. 

I continue improving this update next week so I can release it on the PUBLIC BRANCH as well as soon as possible. Moreover to Mac and Linux users. 

Thank you guys, hope you will like the new features and graphical elements. 



Train Station Simulator Team

notes.title: 0.9.3 update coming on 24th May 2020
notes.content:
In 2019 Train Station Simulator got many major updates. 2020 will be a continuing year for major updates and the testing of new features. The game may will see a final 1.0 release version as well in 2020. 

The greatest update I have made last year was the complete re-coding of Train Station Simulator. I have been finalizing this re-coding for some time as some bugs have not yet been pacthed in the game. With the new code I can happily update the game much-much longer. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31135360/9b6b17620d9a24d565f0365001780bb33c54591c.png[/img]

Let me show your the nine new planned features for the 0.9.3 update:

[h1]1. Train Interiors[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31135360/21dbd04ae1c5e1c21d29857eb1b77db4adeee3f8.jpg[/img]
I plan to enable this features in 0.9.3 version so if you hover your mouse over the train carriages you will be able to see the trains interior and moreover you will be able to see the train filling up with passengers. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31135360/e616fcbb4132c9f015645f243047df56f0dc4698.png[/img]

[h1]2. Freight train additions[/h1]
You will see many more freight train types in the future. With some new cool looking engines and also the addition of new carriages. The new type of goods transported to your freight station will generate different amounts of revenue. This will result more fun of the freight option of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31135360/2684a62a2c27b1abc2939afeb4d02b6b1b16427e.png[/img]

[h1]3. Freight terminal additions[/h1]
Moreover not just new trains and engines will appear but players will be able to create a more complex freight terminal with more trucks and this will also generate more revenue. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31135360/4fb6ee81b1d07e986c2d7b53a153f4e83dd33dcf.png[/img]

[h1]4. Cleaning staff's zoning[/h1]
This major update will add a special feature for some of your staff members. From now on you will be able to add special regions to your cleaning staff members so you can prioritize some parts of your station. Also you can use the same old classic way as per default but this will add some new dimensions to your station. 

[h1]5. New VIP partners[/h1]
In the new version of Train Station Simulator some new VIP passengers will arrive to your station as well. For these very important passengers you will need to build more complex waiting areas with certain criteria. And happy VIP passengers will generate a lot more revenue!

[h1]6. New VIP areas[/h1]
With the new VIP passengers you will have to ability to expand your station layout with a few new luxury facilities that will be used with VIP passengers. 

[h1]7. New passengers carriages[/h1]
Some new type of passengers carriages will arrive as well for these VIP passengers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31135360/a31f6c5a2fd2877658f429c1d7770fc7c2d455b2.jpg[/img]

[h1]8. Underground restaurant court [/h1]
More hungry passengers? No problem. You will be able to build a new larger food court to serve each and every passenger of your station. 

[h1]9. Food Trucks [/h1]
You will be able to add some food trucks along the street side of your game to serve passengers faster.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31135360/3d6bb3aec58142150a822e06aba03511071b6ffe.png[/img]

[h1]10. Console options, controller support [/h1]
I plan to add controller support to the game but this is not yet clear if it will work properly on PC platforms as well. 

Some new screenshots of these features will be announced before the update on the 24th of May! 

As of now I plan to support the game for many years. You have seen major updates in Train Station Simulator since the first release. Last year was a bit quieter but that never means that the game have been abandoned but I am creating more projects as well and sometimes I cannot fully work only on one project. So please keep up guys with your support, ask questions, suggest new features and I will try to add them by time and also would love to hear all your ideas!

Thank you for all You Guys Train Lovers! 

[h1]The 0.9.3 update is coming on 24th May 2020! [/h1]

Stay Safe Everyone!

notes.title: January Update
notes.content:
Hey Guys, 

Thank you guys for all your support in the past year and I really appreciate all the active users being with the community and every new players of Train Station Simulator.

Train Station Simulator has been in Early Access for a little more than 1 year now and I have enabled lots of new features during this time. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31135360/7904169e631644f8d33d4b2d30b4834ae2556087.jpg[/img]

[h1]1. "Where the hell is the latest update? I have waited so long!" [/h1]

You might have realized that the last update of the game (especially on PC and Linux) was in Autumn and I have promised a huge update that should have arrived during 2018. Unfortunately I could not finish up all features and find all the solutions for problems in time that is why this 
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/738610/announcements/detail/1691557965393689649]update[/url] is being delayed. 

The game is actively developed every day but the main reason this new update takes so much time to be completed is more technical related. Train Station Simulator is being developed using a third party game developer engine. This engine got a very large new update during the time of the development of TSS. Right now the old version is still works but I decided to migrate the game to the new version of this engine and I bumped into a few serious issues during this work. The game works more or less but the code needed enormously big re-designing even to be able to work the same way as it did before this update. 

Right now the main sections of the re-code is finished but still I find some nasty bugs every other day with testing.

I cannot tell an exact date when the migration will be finished and all the new features will also be ready but I am on it and doing as much as I can to release the new update. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31135360/a0a006c31373297fc01560a870471d0349fd53a8.jpg[/img]

[h1]2. Leaving Early Access:[/h1]

I plan to finalize Train Station Simulator in 2019 so a first 1.0 version might come to Steam during 2019 with some more features added during this year. 

I plan to continue support for the game and adding regular bug fixes, optimizations and new features upon your requests and ideas. I really need community feedback to decide which features would be the mostly wanted for the game in the future. 

Thank you for your continued support and sorry for the recent delays. All these delays are for the benefits of the game so no time wasted during this time. Hopefully the 0.9 update is arriving soon and we can together with the community continue planning new features for your favorite Builder Simulator game in Train Station Simulator! 

Thank you guys!

notes.title: What's behind Train Station Simulator: an insight of making isometric indie games
notes.content:
Hey Guys, 

We thought it was high time to show you a few tricks we use during game development that might give you some answers on some facts and concerns about the behavior and cause of different things in Train Station Simulator. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31135360/1c1f251e7c7b5d42aae453dad77d9dc9fb42aa0a.jpg[/img]

 [h1] 1. An isometric world: [/h1] 

Most of you know that TSS is an isometric game that is the illusion of 3D of a two dimensional world. Basically we can say that the game takes place on a checked paper with open (GREEN) and forbidden (RED) squares the whole time in 2D. You as a player of the game only sees everything happening in a different projection in isometric 3D. 

Corridors and tiled areas are open spaces but objects, trains and walls are forbidden (partially) places. As an example let's see how an area of a toilette and some tiled areas look like in the 2D Train Station Simulator engine and in the game: 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31135360/bb4295444dc7dfd7501670693428448d96f17121.jpg[/img]

Enabling another layer will show passengers as blue boxes actively moving around. The white less-than // greater than sign indicates the direction the object is moving towards. Some other numbers indicates certain objects as well in your station like 115 for an interactive monitor or 117 for ticketing machines:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31135360/7a47e33626a3d492e615bbe785ea8f195842ef43.jpg[/img]

[h1] 2. Code: "Dead" Backgrounds, "Zombie" mixed elements and "Alive" objects [/h1] 

Most elements in Train Station Simulator are background or active object elements or many elements are both.

As an example flooring are completely background elements, benches are mixed, background and object elements and passengers are objects only. Let me explain this a little more deeply. 

During game development we always pay attention to the speed of FPS (Frames the game runs Per Second) a game can run on maximum. Lots of factor has a huge effect on this (code itself, engine used for development, graphical elements at once on the screen and/or in memory, quality of coding and lots of other factors...).

We use some easy techniques to reduce memory and CPU usage. The biggest advantage is the 2D vs. isometric trick I talked in the first point. The other major possibility is using different elements for different purposes as "dead" background elements will not eat up much memory or CPU but "alive" object will: 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31135360/5705f1c471d63bd98d76c64d57f4ba612006cd3e.jpg[/img]

[u] A.  Background only elements: (Dead) [/u]  
Most flooring, walls, doors, tracks, platforms are "static" elements and are not moving or changing very often. I call them "dead" as these are not moving but sometimes other elements can interact with them (eg.: passengers damage more likely cheap floor and less likely expensive floor). 

[u] B. Mixed, Background and Object elements (Zombie) [/u] 
Most of the interiors to be placed (eg.: benches, machines etc.) are mixed elements. These one have their own rules and functions (eg.: a ticket machine can give a ticket to the passenger or a passenger can use the toilette) so basically we can say that these elements have their own interaction with active objects. These elements cannot interact with each other only with "alive" objects. 

[u] C. Object elements (Alive) [/u] 
Passengers, vandals, staff members, vehicles and trains are active objects in Train Station Simulator. These pieces can interact with A and B types and they can interact with each other as well. For example a passenger can blemish the flooring background only elements, also passengers can sit on a mixed bench element but they feel pretty angry when seeing a vandal passenger destroying machines or missing their train as it leaves the station. 
 
So by understanding the main elements of TSS now you can have a much cleaner picture why there is a limit in the number of passengers (250 right now) or why the map is not much larger. There are other great tricks used in other games where object elements (C) are only active in the view of the game but in TSS it would not be possible as in real world simulation games even if you do not see your passengers they have to continue their behaviors (they are getting more and more tired or hungry and have to catch their trains). 


[h1] 3. The underpass problem: why not possible to move the underpass entrance/exits away from platforms each side or only one side [/h1] 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31135360/27d88dd2a66fe32b5b0c5d6ec42d731fe01c43c4.jpg[/img]

So past week there were some discussions on the new underpass feature. We planned on request to move the entrance/exit of the underpasses off the platforms but as you might now understand more deeply the mechanism of Train Station Simulator it will easy to understand the cause. 

To understand the problem let me introduce a few issues. Train Station Simulator was not designed to be a multi-floored game scene. The "open" // "forbidden" cell system enable "alive objects" to explore around open cells and avoid forbidden cells. The problem is with crossings and the fact that there are no multiple layer levels of that system so it would be difficult to define being on ground level or underground level (Actually we have tried that too but did not work as expected).  

So the next image will show how the underpass works: actually if you place an underpass between tracks it will open a corridor for "forbidden" cells so passengers can cross. The illusion that they "disappear" is only a graphical effect to make it more real and train tracks are forbidden cells as trains use different paths for their movements than passengers. 

 [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31135360/22e3dea2587e5b935ad6d16b2bb1bae73c36d93d.jpg[/img]

The image shows that it is possible to reach from A-B-C-D each point to each other. But moving the underpass entrance/exit each side one cell off the platform would have resulted situation that may caused series blockage that can be seen on the next image: 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31135360/951fc542a68b6373107684f66ed64a490eb494a8.jpg[/img]

In this case "B" would have never been accessed from position "A" as the underpass invisible corridor would block the ground access on the platform. 

Well yeah... We know we could have come up with a solution for that but there were no easy solution for this. We could have created another floor database of coordinates but that would have limited the expanding of passenger number so we had to decide which direction to follow. 

Well this example clearly shows that adding new features needs lots of attention and enormous time to develop! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31135360/a0a006c31373297fc01560a870471d0349fd53a8.jpg[/img]

Hope you guys enjoyed this short insight of the mechanism of Train Station Simulator. We may create posts like this in the future as well and please continue posting comments and feel free asking questions in the future as well. 

Thank you guys!

There was a discussion in one of the update comment sessions about the entrance of these underpasses. We have tested to move the stair entrances off the platforms but that caused some more complicated issues. We will create this week a detailed blog post of the "Insight of developing Train Station Simulator" and you will understand from that post why it was not possible to move the entrances off the platforms. 

You can simple demolish the underpasses with the 2x5 demolish tool. 


[h1] 2. Audio Localization: French [/h1]  
Finally we have updated the audio functions for our French users. 

[h1] 3. Graffiti (Artists) [/h1]  
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31135360/f1aba6a2d535820f930bef48ba005cdfaab092ff.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31135360/59561b186ec70fb4d2a6174cab132325feae5118.jpg[/img]

If you click the Evacuation button again the alarm is stopped and everything turns back to normal. 


[h1] 5. Basic In-game tutorial [/h1]  
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31135360/13e60d3bf8b38843af0a7851172eb7062cf73257.jpg[/img]
We have enabled a short tutorial with basic tips on how to build your very first train station and how to setup your timetables and schedules. This is more useful for very newbie users and was a highly requested feature for long time. 
Right now the tutorial is English only. 


[h1] 6. More transportation: parking lots, disabled person parking [/h1]  
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31135360/98d1871dd06dcbd0a1288b89e2a76490cb9a56a8.jpg[/img]

[h1]8. Mobile phone Charging kiosk [/h1] 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31135360/70e1bd6e7ba88aad0e9fea1be6d900c86ac61fa2.jpg[/img]
Mobile phone Charging Kiosk is an eye candy so you make your station more colorful with facilities like this. Available in 2000 and 2010 all game modes. 

[h1]9. Settings / Force FULL HD Windowed mode [/h1] 
In the settings/display you can use the FullHD Windowed mode that will set 1920x1080 window your game field that was requested as a quick fix for several monitor layouts (as the window size is generated from the screen resolution). 

You may have noticed that some planned features have been left out from this update (disasters, tram lines). These features were moved back on the list to enable certain more important quick fixes. 

Thank you for your help guys, hope to get more fun soon to Train Station Simulator!!

Hey Guys,


We are wishing you all HAPPY NEW YEAR in 2018!


[h1] NEW FEATURES [/h1] 

[h1] Cargo Handling [/h1] 
We are happy to announce that we have enabled the very first TSS Feature Blue voted new options in Train Station Simulator: Cargo Handling

This is a new and not deeply tested feature so you can get errors or weird things. You will find your cargo rail track on the down part of the map.  [b] The Good [/b] 
- unloading each container will earn you $5.000. Not bad at all especially in situations when you need money fast
- unlimited resource, cargo trains come and go often

 [b] The Bad [/b] 
- right now you have to handle this manually,
- in fast mode the ropes are slow: we wanted to avoid catching the ropes on fire! :-)

- no VIP are arriving by train. I suspect if you need more VIP place your Limo station in service. VIP passengers love to eat and love to pay for their quality food in restaurants and their tickets are valid for every train!!
- it is very experimental right now, so expect bugs and issues with these people :-)

- Speed switch now changes for SPACE key

notes.title: Introduction to the "TSS Feature Blue"
notes.content:
We are less than 24 hours of the first, Early Access release of Train Station Simulator! 

[h1]TSS Feature Blue[/h1] 
Our great community is started to build and many of our fans started to share their ideas. The community involvement is a key part of the development of Train Station Simulator further. Today we are happy to announce and introduce you the [b] "TSS Feature Blue" [/b]. Everyone can join this community - communication club by sharing their thoughts here on the community page. 

[h1]How can you join the TSS Feature Blue?[/h1] 
Everyone is in the club who takes active part on the community page by suggesting new ideas and helping other members if they have questions. Most important rule is to be nice to the others and respect everyone's requests. Being positive and adding supportive feedback is an extra point. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31135360/ce48e81bfd61b31aeb22afa60e77b25efb8be2e6.jpg[/img]

Every week or so we plan to select a great idea from our fans and commenters and we will create a [b] "TSS Feature Blue" [/b] image. All members can start up and down vote the image. Each [b] "TSS Feature Blue" [/b] image will be available to vote. The most popular features will than be considered to be an upcoming feature in the game. 

[h1] Important NOTICE to remember [/h1] 
Please consider that these features on these images are NOT YET part of Train Station Simulator and may never be. On the one hand, we would like to create all the features you guys dream. On the other hand, our resources are limited too but we are here for discussion and open for all your suggestions. 

[h1] Selection criteria [/h1] 
The selection of next weeks [b] "TSS Feature Blue" [/b] will be absolutely random but the more active community members will likely have a bigger chance that we see their ideas. All ideas can only be submitted to the community page of [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/738610] Train Station Simulator [/url]. 

This is an absolutely new and innovative plan so we really need the community's help to build this system and maintaining it.  

[h1] Where can I vote to these features / images? [/h1] 
All [b] TSS Feature Blue [/b]  images will be uploaded as an artwork by the dev team. Find the first three images: 
1. [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1230754149] Ticket Gates [/url] 
2. [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1230759415] Cargo Handling [/url] 
3. [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1231071756]  Graffiti Artists [/url]  

You are always welcome to share your own creations but make sure that your artwork does not violate the [url=http://store.steampowered.com//subscriber_agreement/] Steam Subscriber Agreement [/url] or the [url=http://store.steampowered.com//online_conduct/] Steam Online Conduct [/url] rules. Thank you!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31135360/8b9025516a326cba8f5491a7eeb1e956c843e0aa.png[/img]

See you guys all TOMORROW when Train Station Simulator is arriving to your PCs all around the globe!

notes.title: Weekly Update #5
notes.content:
Hey Guys, 

We are very excited about the Early Access release of Train Station Simulator. 

[h1] 14th December - release [/h1] 
If everything goes as it should you can get the game on this 
[b] Thursday 14th December [/b] from Steam! 

We are still fixing some issues and testing out some new features. We have fixed so many bugs that we are not listing everything here now. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31135360/037404b36c2cb157bdda457aa60de45d1f4c4fcb.jpg[/img]

Right now we would like to focus on fixing any appearing issues and tuning the game with the community to make it more easy to play. 

[h1] First weeks - fixing [/h1] 
We believe that in the first few weeks in the Alpha Early Access period we will upload [b] updates twice every day [/b]. We know that it is frustrating to update so often but we believe that in the beginning period of an Early Access game it is important to address serious issues as soon as possible. 

[h1] Next month - enabling existing new features [/h1] 
After all these issues have been fixed and the game has been balanced to most players like we plan to enable some other features that is already in the game but we are still testing them. Let me put these feature in a list:
[list]
    [*] evacuation doors
    [*] station evacuation
    [*] beggers, homeless persons, graffiti guys
    [*] SWAT team members
    [*] unattended luggage in the terminal 
    [*] rail problems
    [*] trees on the rails
    [*] mod options and station map sharing system
    [*] mail transportation, mail carriages, mailing cars
    [*] cargo operations
[/list] 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31135360/a8424bd86c93e2b4560b52dbfdfdc70404e07686.png[/img]

We have some further plans for some awesome features that are listed on the community page with a cool image!
